case_title: ANTHONY EDWARD VICORY VS. COMCAST CORPORATION

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-23-2018 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO NOV-15-2018 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ANTHONY EDWARD VICORY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT COMCAST CORPORATION IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY JVON CHAVEZ, ELR SUPERVISOR. PER THE PLAINTIFF, THE PARTIES REACHED A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT PRIOR TO THE HEARING. IF THERE ARE NO APPEARANCES AT THE NOVEMBER 15TH HEARING, MATTER TO BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)

SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF VICORY, ANTHONY EDWARD AS TO DEFENDANT COMCAST CORPORATION
